note: Both models independently reviewed this exact payload criterion by criterion. Codex consolidated their evidence. AI-assisted editorial review only; no human reviewer or learner testing.

criteria.prompt: Original/permitted source, author, distribution rights and no learner PII checked.
criteria.evidence:
Luna: Pack attributes an original AI-assisted reading to the project, states no copied exam text/external source/learner data, and the inspected payload contains no learner PII; rights are based on this declaration, not external provenance verification.
Sol: Checked provenance: named Dual Dictionary project as AI-assisted author, original source declaration and explicit generation/distribution authorization. Reading contains no learner personal data. Rights assessment relies on supplied provenance; no external authorship verification.

criteria.prompt: Phrase occurs in cited source and the contextual sense is supported.
criteria.evidence:
Luna: Exact phrase occurs in s1, describing a university team conducting a tree survey.
Sol: s1 contains exact carry out a survey; s2 specifies recording species, trunk width and distance, supporting systematic information collection.

criteria.prompt: English gloss is the actual contextual meaning, not a selection rationale.
criteria.evidence:
Luna: Gloss accurately describes conducting a systematic information-gathering study.
Sol: Conducting a systematic study to collect information accurately describes the tree survey, without assuming that all surveys are questionnaires.

criteria.prompt: Vietnamese gloss is accurate, natural and includes diacritics.
criteria.evidence:
Luna: “tiến hành một cuộc khảo sát” is natural and accurate Vietnamese with diacritics.
Sol: tiến hành một cuộc khảo sát accurately and naturally renders the phrase, with complete Vietnamese diacritics.

criteria.prompt: Phrase occurs in cited source and the contextual sense is supported.

criteria.prompt: English gloss is the actual contextual meaning, not a selection rationale.

criteria.prompt: Identify correct option and explain each distractor. No other plausible answer; no subjective style/intent assumptions.
criteria.evidence:
Luna: a alone describes conducting the study; b–d introduce relocation, exercise or traffic control absent from the text.
Sol: a uniquely means conducting a systematic tree study. b relocates trees; c is exercise; d stops traffic. These do not mean carrying out the survey. Citation s1 is correct.

criteria.prompt: Every option explanation is accurate; grammar/collocation claims are not overgeneralized.
criteria.evidence:
Luna: Explanations accurately distinguish research/data collection from the unrelated actions in b–d.
Sol: All four option explanations and overall explanation accurately distinguish collecting research data from relocation, physical exercise and traffic intervention.

criteria.prompt: Identify correct option and explain each distractor. No other plausible answer; no subjective style/intent assumptions.
criteria.evidence:
Luna: b is the only grammatical target use; a lacks article a, c substitutes off, and d uses carries after will.
Sol: b uses carry out a survey naturally. a lacks the determiner on singular survey; c substitutes carry off for the target research expression; d incorrectly uses carries after will. Citation s1 is valid.

criteria.prompt: Every option explanation is accurate; grammar/collocation claims are not overgeneralized.

criteria.prompt: Role or purpose differs meaningfully from the source; not merely rewriting it.
criteria.evidence:
Luna: A sports club schedule message changes role, topic and purpose from the university research report.
Sol: Sports club welcome message highlighting a weekend practice time differs in role and communicative purpose from an academic tree report. Citation s3 remains valid.

criteria.prompt: Model answer is idiomatic and uses target; checklist is usable; writing is not automatically graded.
criteria.evidence:

Sol: Sample has two sentences, naturally uses I want to point out that with a specific practice time/location. Checklist covers sentence count, schedule fact and changed context; explanation explicitly states self-assessment and no automatic grade.
